scripts.build:tui: bun run build:tui:core && bun run build:tui:plugins
scripts.install:tui:plugins: bun run build:plugin:official && cargo install --path crates/agent-tui --locked --force --features plugins && bun run setup:tui
scripts.build:plugin:official: bun run build:plugin:context && bun run build:plugin:mcp && bun run build:plugin:skill && bun run build:plugin:command
scripts.test:plugin:context: cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/context-plugin/Cargo.toml && bun run build:plugin:context && cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/context-plugin/smoke-tests/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:plugin:mcp: cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/mcp-plugin/Cargo.toml && bun run build:plugin:mcp && cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/mcp-plugin/smoke-tests/Cargo.toml -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:plugin:skill: cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/skill-plugin/Cargo.toml && bun run build:plugin:skill && cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/skill-plugin/smoke-tests/Cargo.toml -- --ignored --nocapture
scripts.test:plugin:command: cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/command-plugin/Cargo.toml --workspace && bun run build:plugin:command && cargo test --offline --manifest-path examples/plugins/command-plugin/smoke-tests/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:plugin:official: bun run test:plugin:context && bun run test:plugin:mcp && bun run test:plugin:skill && bun run test:plugin:command
scripts.perf:plugin:wasm: bun run build:plugin:context && cargo run --offline --release --manifest-path examples/plugins/context-plugin/smoke-tests/Cargo.toml --example perf
scripts.test:live: bun run build:plugin:echo && cargo run --offline --manifest-path tools/lucia-live-tests/Cargo.toml --
